mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN BUDGET_VALUE > 0 THEN ACTUAL_VALUE / BUDGET_VALUE * 100 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS EXEC_RATE, ROUND(AVG(ABS(NVL(VARIANCE_RATE, 0))), 2) AS DEVIATION_RATE, ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(BUDGET_VALUE, 0)) > 0 THEN (SUM(NVL(BUDGET_VALUE, 0)) - SUM(NVL(ACTUAL_VALUE, 0))) / SUM(NVL(BUDGET_VALUE, 0)) * 100 ELSE 0 END, 2) AS COST_SAVE_RATE FROM TBL_NCV_BUDGET_DATA WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND BUDGET_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND BUDGET_VALUE > 0 AND ACTUAL_VALUE IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS COMPLETED_COUNT, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM TBL_BUDGET_TASK WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_BUDGET_TASK WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND TASK_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SUBMITTED')
